title: Ensure bank errors and irregularities are detected and investigated promptly.
description:
Bank reconciliations are prepared promptly each month and reviewed and signed off by a person independent of cash handling, who investigates aged or unusual items.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Monthly

Responsible: Finance manager, independent of cash handling

Evidence of operation: Signed reconciliations with review notes and documented follow-up of outstanding items.

Limitations: Review may be superficial; will not detect items omitted from both the bank statement and the books.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select bank reconciliations for several months spread across the period. Inspect for preparer and independent reviewer sign-off, verify the reviewer is independent of cash handling, re-perform one reconciliation, and inspect the investigation of aged or unusual items.

title: Prevent stale items from permanently distorting the reported cash balance.
description:
Aged outstanding items (unpresented cheques, deposits in transit) are investigated and cleared or written back within a defined timeframe.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Monthly

Responsible: Finance manager

Evidence of operation: Aged items listing with investigation notes and resolution.

Limitations: Depends on the reviewer genuinely investigating rather than carrying items forward.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the aged outstanding-items report at two dates. Verify items beyond the defined timeframe were investigated and cleared or written back with approval, and trace a sample of clearances to supporting evidence.

title: Prevent payments to fictitious or improper beneficiaries.
description:
New beneficiaries are independently verified (business existence, bank account ownership) before the first payment is made.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Each new beneficiary

Responsible: Finance / procurement, independent of payment processing

Evidence of operation: Beneficiary verification checklist with supporting documents.

Limitations: Verification documents can be forged; does not prevent subsequent diversion of payments to changed bank details.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of new beneficiaries added during the period. Inspect verification evidence (business existence, bank account ownership) dated before the first payment, and verify no payment preceded verification.

title: Ensure only genuine, properly supported payments are released.
description:
Payments above defined thresholds require dual authorisation, and supporting documents are matched to the payment before release.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Each payment run

Responsible: Authorised signatories (two)

Evidence of operation: Authorised payment batches with matched supporting documents.

Limitations: Can be overridden by management; authorisers may approve without examining supporting documents.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of payments above the threshold. Inspect for dual authorisation and matched supporting documents, and verify the authorisers are independent of the payment requester. Verify the system enforces dual authorisation (inspect configuration or test with a controlled attempt).

title: Ensure inter-account transfers are completely and accurately recorded on both sides.
description:
All transfers between the entity's bank accounts are logged in a transfer register and matched on both the sending and receiving sides before period-end close.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Each transfer / at period-end

Responsible: Treasury / finance

Evidence of operation: Transfer register with both-side matching evidence and sign-off.

Limitations: Will not detect transfers deliberately excluded from the register; depends on completeness of the log.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of inter-account transfers. Trace each to the transfer register and agree both the sending and receiving sides, and inspect the period-end matching performed before close.

title: Prevent cut-off errors and window dressing through year-end transfers.
description:
Year-end bank cut-off procedures require transfers in transit at the reporting date to be identified, listed and correctly presented (not double-counted).

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Year-end

Responsible: Finance manager

Evidence of operation: Year-end in-transit schedule agreed to bank statements on both sides.

Limitations: Only as complete as the transfer register and the statements obtained; post year-end reversals may not be visible.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the year-end listing of transfers in transit. Verify each item is recognised on only one side (not double-counted) and re-perform the cut-off check for the reporting date.

title: Detect shortages or misappropriation of cash on hand.
description:
Independent surprise cash counts are performed, reconciled to the cash records, and differences investigated and approved.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Periodic, unannounced

Responsible: Finance / internal audit, independent of cash custody

Evidence of operation: Count sheets signed by the counter, reconciliation to records, investigation of differences.

Limitations: Only proves the position at the count date; ineffective if the counter colludes with the cashier.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the records of surprise cash counts during the period. Verify the counts were unannounced and performed by someone independent of cash custody, verify differences were investigated and approved, and observe one count.

title: Prevent unauthorised removal of physical cash.
description:
Cash on hand is held under dual custody, all receipts are issued pre-numbered receipts, and takings are banked promptly and intact.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Ongoing

Responsible: Cashier / supervisor

Evidence of operation: Receipt books, banking slips, dual-control logs.

Limitations: Dual custody can be defeated by collusion; does not prevent theft before receipting.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Observe cash handling: dual custody in operation and pre-numbered receipts issued. Select a sample of days and agree takings to bankings, verifying banking was prompt and intact.

title: Prevent unauthorised or unsupported manual journals, the primary vehicle for management override.
description:
All manual journal entries above a defined threshold require approval by a person independent of the preparer before posting; approval is evidenced by signature or system workflow.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Per journal entry

Responsible: Finance manager / financial controller

Evidence of operation: Journal approval log or workflow audit trail showing preparer, approver and timestamps.

Limitations: Does not prevent collusion between preparer and approver; management override can bypass it.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of manual journals above the threshold. Inspect for independent approval before posting (signature or workflow timestamp) and verify the approver differs from the preparer.

title: Detect fraud and override by giving staff a safe route to report concerns.
description:
A whistleblowing policy with a reporting channel independent of line management, communicated to all staff, with reports logged, investigated and reported to those charged with governance.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Ongoing

Responsible: Those charged with governance / ethics officer

Evidence of operation: Policy document, communication records, log of reports received and investigation outcomes.

Limitations: Ineffective if staff do not trust the channel or fear retaliation; absence of reports does not prove absence of fraud.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the whistleblowing policy and evidence of its communication to staff. Inspect the log of reports, investigation records and reporting to those charged with governance, and confirm the reporting channel is operational.

title: Increase the chance that concealed misappropriation is exposed when someone else performs the role.
description:
Staff in cash-handling, payment and recording roles are required to take periodic uninterrupted leave, with their duties performed by others during absence; key roles are rotated where feasible.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Periodic

Responsible: Human resources / line management

Evidence of operation: Leave records, handover notes, rotation schedule.

Limitations: Disruptive to operations; does not detect frauds that do not require the perpetrator's continuous presence.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of staff in covered roles. Verify periodic uninterrupted leave was taken per policy, verify duties were performed by others during the absence, and inspect rotation records where applicable.

title: Detect and deter systematic management bias in estimates.
description:
Significant accounting estimates are independently reviewed and challenged by someone without responsibility for preparing them, with the challenge documented, before the financial statements are finalised.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Per reporting period

Responsible: CFO / audit committee

Evidence of operation: Review checklist or memo documenting assumptions challenged and conclusions reached.

Limitations: A reviewer who defers to management adds no assurance; challenge must be genuine and evidenced.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select significant accounting estimates. Inspect the documented independent challenge, including the challenger's conclusions, and verify the challenger had no responsibility for preparing the estimate.

title: Prevent premature or fictitious revenue recognition driven by target pressure.
description:
Revenue cut-off and recognition for material or unusual transactions are reviewed by a function independent of sales, with supporting dispatch and acceptance evidence inspected before revenue is recorded.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Per reporting period

Responsible: Finance, independent of sales

Evidence of operation: Cut-off checklist, review sign-off, matched dispatch/delivery evidence.

Limitations: Does not address fictitious sales supported by fabricated dispatch documents; depends on the reviewer's scepticism.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select material or unusual revenue transactions. Inspect evidence of review by a function independent of sales, including the dispatch and acceptance evidence inspected before revenue was recorded.

title: Ensure manual journals are valid, supported and independently checked before they affect the ledger.
description:
All manual journals above a defined threshold require documented supporting evidence and independent approval before posting; the preparer cannot approve their own journal.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Per journal

Responsible: Finance manager

Evidence of operation: Journal approval records showing preparer, independent approver, date, and attached support.

Limitations: Approval may be perfunctory; approvers under time pressure at period-end may sign without review; collusion defeats segregation.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of manual journals above the threshold. Inspect supporting evidence and independent pre-posting approval, and verify segregation between preparer and approver.

title: Detect unusual or potentially inappropriate manual journals after posting.
description:
A complete, sequentially controlled listing of manual journals is reviewed periodically for unusual entries - round amounts, postings outside normal hours, vague descriptions, entries by senior staff, or entries to seldom-used accounts.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Monthly

Responsible: Financial controller

Evidence of operation: Review working papers with follow-up notes on items investigated.

Limitations: Only as good as the reviewer's skepticism and knowledge of what is unusual; a reviewer who does not understand the business will miss subtle indicators.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the periodic reviews of the complete manual-journal listing. Verify the review covered the full population (sequential control), select unusual entries flagged and inspect the follow-up.

title: Provide independent oversight that deters and detects management override.
description:
Those charged with governance (for example an audit committee) oversee the financial reporting process, review significant judgments and unusual journals, and maintain a channel through which concerns about override or fraud can be raised.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Quarterly

Responsible: Audit committee / board

Evidence of operation: Meeting minutes evidencing challenge of judgments and review of unusual items; records of concerns raised and how they were addressed.

Limitations: Governance oversight is periodic and high-level; it cannot prevent a determined override between meetings, and its effectiveness depends on the independence and competence of those involved.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect audit committee minutes for review of significant judgements and unusual journals, and verify the concerns channel to those charged with governance exists and was communicated.

title: Restrict and make visible the system-level actions through which override is typically exercised.
description:
Privileged and administrator access to the accounting system is restricted to those who need it, all privileged actions are logged, logs are reviewed, and direct posting to closed periods is technically blocked.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Automated

Frequency: Ongoing

Responsible: IT / system administrator

Evidence of operation: Access-right listings, privileged-action logs and evidence of periodic log review.

Limitations: A privileged user can potentially alter or delete logs; the control reduces opportunity but cannot eliminate override by those who administer the system itself.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the privileged-access listing and verify access is restricted to those who need it. Inspect the reviews of privileged-action logs, and verify direct posting to closed periods is technically blocked (inspect configuration or test).

title: Ensure related-party relationships are known so transactions with them can be identified.
description:
A register of related parties is maintained and kept current for changes in directors, key management, significant shareholders and their close family members and controlled entities; declarations of interest are obtained periodically.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Periodic (and on change)

Responsible: Company secretary / finance

Evidence of operation: The related-party register with update history and signed declarations of interest.

Limitations: Relies on individuals declaring their interests honestly and completely; complex or concealed structures may not be declared.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the related-party register and verify it was updated for changes in directors, key management and significant shareholders during the period. Select a sample of declarations and agree them to the register.

title: Identify related-party transactions at the point of approval.
description:
Transactions above a defined threshold are screened against the related-party register before approval, and identified related-party transactions are flagged for appropriate measurement and disclosure.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Per transaction

Responsible: Finance / budget holder

Evidence of operation: Approval records showing the related-party check and flagging of identified transactions.

Limitations: Screening is only as complete as the register; transactions structured to avoid thresholds escape the check.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of transactions above the threshold. Verify each was screened against the related-party register before approval, and for identified related-party transactions verify flagging for appropriate measurement and disclosure.

title: Ensure provisions are based on supportable assumptions that have been independently challenged.
description:
Provision calculations, including all key assumptions, are prepared with supporting evidence and are reviewed and challenged by someone independent of the preparer before the financial statements are finalised.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: At each reporting date

Responsible: Finance director

Evidence of operation: Provision working papers showing preparer, independent reviewer, challenge points and how they were resolved.

Limitations: A reviewer without the expertise or the willingness to challenge adds little; management bias can survive a polite review.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select provisions. Inspect the supporting evidence for key assumptions and the documented independent challenge performed before the financial statements were finalised.

title: Detect patterns of optimistic or pessimistic bias in provisioning.
description:
Significant estimates are compared with subsequent actual outcomes (look-back review); systematic differences are investigated for bias.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Annual

Responsible: Finance

Evidence of operation: Look-back analyses with investigation notes on significant variances.

Limitations: Backward-looking; detects bias only after the event, and a single year's variance may have innocent explanations.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the look-back comparison of prior estimates to actual outcomes. Verify systematic differences were investigated for bias and that conclusions were reported.

title: Ensure all required disclosures are considered and included.
description:
A disclosure checklist based on the applicable financial reporting framework is completed for each set of financial statements and reviewed by a technically competent person independent of the preparer.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: At each reporting date

Responsible: Financial reporting manager / technical reviewer

Evidence of operation: Completed and reviewed disclosure checklist cross-referenced to the financial statements.

Limitations: A checklist completed mechanically, or one not updated for new standards and transactions, gives false comfort.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the completed disclosure checklist. Verify it reflects the applicable financial reporting framework and was independently reviewed by a technically competent person, and trace a sample of disclosures to the checklist.

title: Catch disclosure requirements arising from transactions the checklist alone might miss.
description:
New, unusual or complex transactions are assessed for disclosure implications during the close process, and the assessment is documented.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: At each reporting date

Responsible: Financial reporting manager

Evidence of operation: Close file notes assessing disclosure implications of new transactions.

Limitations: Relies on preparers recognising that a transaction is new or unusual; routine carry-forward thinking misses novel items.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select new, unusual or complex transactions during the period. Verify each had a documented disclosure assessment during the close process and that conclusions were reviewed.

title: Ensure all sites with restoration obligations are identified.
description:
A complete register of network sites is maintained, capturing lease terms and restoration/dismantling clauses, and is reconciled to the lease portfolio annually.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Annual

Responsible: Network operations / finance

Evidence of operation: Reconciled site register with restoration-clause flags; review sign-off.

Limitations: Only as good as the underlying lease data; new sites may be missed.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the network site register and verify restoration and dismantling clauses are captured. Verify the annual reconciliation to the lease portfolio, and select sites to agree clauses to the underlying leases.

title: Ensure the provision is measured on supportable assumptions.
description:
The decommissioning provision model (cost estimates, timing, discount rate, unwinding) is reviewed and approved by management each reporting date.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Annual

Responsible: Financial controller

Evidence of operation: Approved provision calculation with assumption support.

Limitations: Management review may lack challenge where assumptions are highly technical.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect management's review of the decommissioning provision model (cost estimates, timing, discount rate, unwinding) at the reporting date. Verify approval and re-perform key inputs.

title: Prevent unsupported allocation keys entering the billing system.
description:
New tariff plans and bundle structures are independently reviewed and approved, including the stand-alone selling prices used for allocation, before launch.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Per new plan

Responsible: Product / finance

Evidence of operation: Tariff approval forms with allocation basis documented.

Limitations: Review may be a formality under launch pressure.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select new tariff plans and bundle structures launched. Verify independent review and approval, including the stand-alone selling prices used for allocation, before launch.

title: Ensure allocation is applied consistently to all contracts.
description:
The billing and revenue system automatically allocates consideration per the approved configuration, with changes to allocation logic restricted and logged.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Automated

Frequency: Ongoing

Responsible: IT / revenue assurance

Evidence of operation: Change logs and restricted access rights.

Limitations: An automated control faithfully applies a wrong configuration.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the allocation-logic change log. Verify changes to allocation logic were restricted and logged, and re-perform the allocation for a sample of contracts.

title: Detect unrated or misrated usage before billing.
description:
Rating exception and rejection reports are reviewed daily and rejected usage records are investigated and reprocessed or resolved.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: IT-dependent manual

Frequency: Daily

Responsible: Revenue assurance

Evidence of operation: Reviewed exception logs with resolution notes.

Limitations: Reviewers may clear exceptions without proper investigation under volume pressure.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select days and inspect the rating exception and rejection reports with review evidence. Select rejected usage records and verify investigation and reprocessing or resolution.

title: Prevent defective rating logic reaching production.
description:
Tariff and rating configuration changes are tested in a non-production environment and independently approved before deployment.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Per change

Responsible: Billing IT / finance

Evidence of operation: Test results and deployment approvals.

Limitations: Testing may not cover all tariff combinations.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select tariff and rating configuration changes deployed. Verify testing in a non-production environment and independent approval before deployment.

title: Keep absorption rates current and capacity assumptions realistic.
description:
Overhead absorption rates and the normal-capacity assumption are set from approved budgets and reviewed when budgets change or capacity shifts materially.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Annual / on budget change

Responsible: Cost accounting / finance

Evidence of operation: Approved rate-setting papers with budget support.

Limitations: Budgets themselves may be optimistic.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the approved budgets supporting the overhead absorption rates. Verify rates were updated when budgets changed or capacity shifted materially, and re-perform the rate calculation for one period.

title: Prevent capitalisation of abnormal production costs.
description:
Abnormal idle-capacity costs are identified and expensed rather than absorbed into inventory.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Monthly

Responsible: Plant finance

Evidence of operation: Capacity utilisation reports with idle-cost analysis.

Limitations: The normal/abnormal boundary is judgmental.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select months and inspect the identification of abnormal idle-capacity costs. Verify they were expensed rather than absorbed into inventory, and trace them to profit or loss.

title: Ensure variances are understood and standards stay current.
description:
Material cost variances are investigated monthly, with findings documented and standards updated where the variance reflects a permanent cost change.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Monthly

Responsible: Cost accounting

Evidence of operation: Variance investigation reports with conclusions.

Limitations: Investigations may conclude too readily that variances are 'timing'.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select months and inspect the documented investigation of material cost variances. Where standards were updated, verify the update reflected a permanent cost change and was approved.

title: Keep the provision aligned with emerging claims data.
description:
Warranty claims are tracked by product cohort and the provision model is updated for actual claim experience each reporting date.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Quarterly / annual

Responsible: Finance / after-sales

Evidence of operation: Cohort claim analyses feeding the provision model.

Limitations: New products have no history to track.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect warranty claims tracking by product cohort. Verify the provision model was updated for actual claim experience at the reporting date, and re-perform the model inputs for one cohort.

title: Detect missing takings promptly.
description:
Daily till reconciliations are performed, independently reviewed, and differences investigated; bankings agree to till records.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Daily

Responsible: Store supervisor / finance

Evidence of operation: Signed till sheets, banking slips, investigation notes.

Limitations: Collusion between till operator and reviewer defeats it.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select days and inspect till reconciliations with independent review. Verify differences were investigated, and agree bankings to till records.

title: Prevent fictitious voids/refunds as a skimming method.
description:
Voids, refunds and discounts require supervisor authorisation with reason codes, and are reviewed for unusual patterns.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Ongoing

Responsible: Store supervisor

Evidence of operation: Authorised void/refund logs.

Limitations: Supervisor may be the perpetrator.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select voids, refunds and discounts. Verify supervisor authorisation with reason codes, and inspect the pattern review for unusual activity.

title: Ensure income is recognised only on agreed terms.
description:
Rebate agreements are documented, with tiered terms captured in a rebate schedule reviewed by finance before income is recognised.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Per agreement

Responsible: Commercial finance

Evidence of operation: Signed agreements and approved rebate schedules.

Limitations: Informal side deals may bypass documentation.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select rebate agreements. Verify documented terms and finance's review of the rebate schedule before income was recognised, and re-perform one rebate calculation.

title: Ensure the liability is complete and breakage is authorised.
description:
Gift card and loyalty liabilities are reconciled between the POS/loyalty system and the general ledger each period, with breakage assumptions approved.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: IT-dependent manual

Frequency: Monthly

Responsible: Finance

Evidence of operation: Reconciliations with approval; breakage papers.

Limitations: Reconciliation proves arithmetic, not correct breakage.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select periods and inspect the reconciliation of gift card and loyalty liabilities between the POS/loyalty system and the general ledger. Verify breakage assumptions were approved, and re-perform the reconciliation.

title: Ensure the impairment estimate is controlled and challenged.
description:
The ECL model is independently validated, staging criteria are documented, and significant staging decisions and overlays are approved with documented rationale.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Annual / quarterly

Responsible: Risk / finance

Evidence of operation: Validation reports; staging committee minutes; overlay approvals.

Limitations: Validation may lag model changes.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the independent validation report on the ECL model. Select a sample of significant staging decisions and overlays; inspect the documented rationale and evidence of approval, and verify the approver is independent of the modelling team.

title: Prevent accrual of uncollectible interest.
description:
Interest accrual is automatically suspended when a loan meets defined non-performance criteria, with any exception requiring documented approval.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Automated

Frequency: Ongoing

Responsible: Credit operations / IT

Evidence of operation: System configuration; exception approvals.

Limitations: Criteria may be set too leniently.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the system configuration for the automatic interest-suspension rule. Select a sample of loans meeting the defined non-performance criteria and verify interest accrual stopped; for any exception, inspect the documented approval.

title: Ensure valuations and classifications are not set by the front office alone.
description:
Independent price verification is performed on treasury valuations, with model inputs and classifications reviewed by a function independent of the trading desk.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Monthly

Responsible: Risk / product control

Evidence of operation: IPV reports with investigation of differences.

Limitations: Independent sources may not exist for level 3 instruments.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of treasury valuations; inspect the independent price verification evidence and verify the reviewer is independent of the trading desk. Re-perform one IPV check.

title: Prevent unauthorised removal of inventory.
description:
Physical access to warehouse and high-value storage areas is restricted to authorised personnel, with access rights reviewed periodically.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Ongoing

Responsible: Warehouse manager

Evidence of operation: Access authorisation lists; key/card issuance logs; periodic access-right reviews signed off by management.

Limitations: Does not detect theft by authorised personnel; can be overridden by collusion or management override.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Observe physical access controls at the warehouse and high-value storage. Inspect the authorised-personnel list, verify access rights were reviewed periodically, and inspect access logs for anomalies.

title: Detect unrecorded inventory losses and ensure records agree with physical quantities.
description:
Independent physical inventory counts are performed periodically and differences between counted quantities and inventory records are investigated and approved before adjustment.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Periodic (e.g. cycle counts or annual full count)

Responsible: Finance / internal audit, independent of warehouse custody

Evidence of operation: Count sheets, reconciliation of counts to records, investigation notes and approved adjustment journals.

Limitations: Only detects losses at the count date; ineffective if counters are not independent or differences are written off without investigation.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Attend or observe one physical count. Inspect count records for other periods, select differences between counted quantities and records, and verify investigation and approval before adjustment.

title: Ensure terminated employees are removed promptly so no further payments are processed.
description:
HR issues a leaver notification to payroll on or before the employee's last working day, and payroll confirms removal from the payroll master before the next pay run.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Each termination

Responsible: HR officer / payroll officer

Evidence of operation: Signed leaver checklist; payroll master change log showing the removal date.

Limitations: Can be bypassed by collusion between HR and payroll; ineffective if the notification step is skipped under time pressure.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of leavers. Verify the HR leaver notification was on or before the last working day, and verify removal from the payroll master before the next pay run (no payment after leaving).

title: Detect ghost or terminated employees remaining on the payroll.
description:
An independent person reconciles the payroll master headcount to HR employment records each pay period and investigates differences.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Each pay period

Responsible: Finance manager, independent of payroll processing

Evidence of operation: Signed reconciliation with documented follow-up of differences.

Limitations: Only as good as the HR records it is compared against; will not detect collusion that falsifies both sides.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select pay periods and inspect the independent reconciliation of payroll headcount to HR employment records. Verify differences were investigated, and re-perform one reconciliation.

title: Prevent unauthorised or fictitious changes to employee master data.
description:
Payroll master changes (new starters, leavers, pay rate and bank detail changes) require independent approval before they take effect.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Each master change

Responsible: HR manager / finance manager, independent of payroll processing

Evidence of operation: Approved change request forms or system workflow approvals; audit trail of changes.

Limitations: Can be overridden by management; ineffective against collusion between the requester and the approver.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of master changes (new starters, leavers, pay-rate and bank-detail changes). Inspect independent approval before effect, and verify no change took effect unapproved by comparing effective dates to approval dates.

title: Prevent one person from both creating a payee and paying them.
description:
System access rights segregate payroll master maintenance from payroll payment processing and release, and access rights are reviewed periodically.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Automated

Frequency: Ongoing, with periodic review

Responsible: IT / finance management

Evidence of operation: User access rights report; periodic access review signed off by management.

Limitations: Access reviews may be perfunctory; privileged IT users may bypass application-level controls.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect system access rights and verify no user holds both payroll-master-maintenance and payment-release rights. Inspect the periodic review of access rights.

title: Ensure only genuine, necessary overtime is paid.
description:
Overtime is approved in advance (or promptly afterwards) by a supervisor independent of the claimant, based on operational need.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Each overtime claim

Responsible: Line supervisor

Evidence of operation: Approved overtime claim forms or system approval records.

Limitations: Supervisors may approve routinely without real scrutiny; does not detect collusion between claimant and supervisor.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of overtime claims. Inspect approval in advance (or promptly afterwards) by a supervisor independent of the claimant, and verify operational need was documented.

title: Detect excessive or anomalous overtime claims.
description:
An exception report of overtime by employee and department is reviewed periodically and unusual patterns are investigated.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Monthly

Responsible: Finance / HR manager

Evidence of operation: Reviewed exception report with investigation notes and sign-off.

Limitations: Review may be high-level; effectiveness depends on defined thresholds and genuine follow-up.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select months and inspect the overtime exception report with review evidence. Select unusual patterns flagged and verify investigation.

title: Ensure payroll is calculated from correct, current rates and parameters.
description:
Payroll rate tables, tax tables and deduction parameters are updated from authoritative sources, and changes are independently reviewed before the pay run.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Each update / each pay period

Responsible: Payroll manager / finance manager

Evidence of operation: Updated parameter tables with reviewer sign-off; change log.

Limitations: Reviewer may not verify the source of the parameters; configuration errors in the payroll system may not be visible in the tables.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect updates to payroll rate, tax and deduction tables. Verify the source is authoritative and changes were independently reviewed before the pay run, and re-perform one employee's calculation.

title: Detect calculation errors and ensure payroll agrees with the accounting records.
description:
The payroll summary is independently reviewed and reconciled to the general ledger before payments are released.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Each pay period

Responsible: Finance manager, independent of payroll processing

Evidence of operation: Reviewed and signed payroll summary; payroll-to-GL reconciliation.

Limitations: A high-level review may not detect systematic calculation errors affecting all employees equally.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select pay periods. Inspect the independent review of the payroll summary and its reconciliation to the general ledger, and verify differences were resolved before payments were released.

title: Ensure only expenditure meeting the capitalisation criteria is recognised as property, plant and equipment.
description:
Capital expenditure, including the capitalisation of repairs and major maintenance, requires documented approval against the entity's capitalisation criteria before the amount is recognised as an asset.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Per transaction

Responsible: Finance manager / budget holder

Evidence of operation: Approved capital expenditure request forms with a completed capitalisation-criteria checklist and authorising signature.

Limitations: The approver may not fully understand the accounting criteria; the control can be bypassed by miscoding expenditure or by collusion.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of capital additions. Inspect documented approval against the entity's capitalisation criteria before recognition, and verify the approver assessed the criteria (not just the budget).

title: Detect misclassification between repairs expense and capital additions.
description:
Finance reviews the repairs and maintenance expense accounts each period for items that appear capital in nature, and reviews capital additions for items that appear to be repairs, investigating and correcting anomalies.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Monthly or quarterly

Responsible: Financial accountant

Evidence of operation: Periodic review working papers with follow-up notes and correcting entries where applicable.

Limitations: A review detects only what the reviewer notices; subtle misclassifications near the capitalisation boundary may pass unchallenged.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select periods and inspect finance's review of the repairs and maintenance accounts for capital items, and of capital additions for repairs items. Select items investigated and verify the conclusions.

title: Ensure depreciation reflects the expected pattern of consumption of future economic benefits.
description:
Management reviews depreciation rates, methods, useful lives and residual values at least annually, approves any changes, and documents the rationale for the conclusions reached.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Annual

Responsible: Finance director

Evidence of operation: Signed annual review memorandum with supporting analysis of asset usage, condition and technological change.

Limitations: The review is only as good as the information and challenge applied; management may retain favourable lives to flatter profit.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the annual review of depreciation rates, methods, useful lives and residual values. Verify changes were approved with documented rationale, and verify estimate changes were applied prospectively.

title: Prevent unauthorised or undocumented changes to depreciation parameters.
description:
The fixed asset system calculates depreciation automatically from approved asset master data; any change to a depreciation rate, method or useful life requires independent authorisation and is logged.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Automated

Frequency: On change

Responsible: System administrator / finance

Evidence of operation: System change logs and authorisation records for master-data amendments.

Limitations: Does not address whether the approved lives are appropriate; an authorised but inappropriate life will still be applied consistently.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the asset-master change log. Select changes to depreciation parameters and verify independent authorisation, and verify the log is complete (no unauthorised changes).

title: Ensure every disposal is authorised and removed from the accounting records.
description:
All disposals of property, plant and equipment require prior written authorisation and completion of a disposal form, which is forwarded to finance so the asset is removed from the register and the ledger.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Per disposal

Responsible: Operations manager

Evidence of operation: Authorised disposal forms filed with derecognition entries; sequential control over disposal forms.

Limitations: Ineffective if operations staff dispose of assets without completing the form, or if forms are not forwarded to finance.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of disposals. Inspect prior written authorisation and the completed disposal form, and verify the asset was removed from the register and the ledger.

title: Detect assets that no longer exist but remain on the register.
description:
Physical verification of fixed assets is performed periodically by persons independent of custody; differences between the physical assets located and the register are investigated and the register corrected.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Periodic (e.g. annual or rolling cycle)

Responsible: Internal audit / finance, independent of custody

Evidence of operation: Verification sheets, investigation notes and approved register adjustments.

Limitations: Detects missing assets only at the verification date; cannot identify exactly when an asset was disposed of.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Observe or inspect one physical verification of fixed assets. Verify the verifiers were independent of custody, select differences found and verify investigation and correction of the register.

title: Ensure impairment indicators are identified so that impairment testing is performed when required.
description:
Management performs an assessment of impairment indicators for each asset or cash-generating unit at each reporting date and documents the conclusion, including the basis for concluding that no formal impairment test is required.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Annual (at each reporting date)

Responsible: Finance director / management

Evidence of operation: Impairment indicator checklist or memorandum, signed off and dated.

Limitations: Management may overlook or downplay indicators, particularly where an impairment charge would be unwelcome; the assessment needs genuine challenge.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the impairment-indicator assessment at the reporting date. Verify it covers each asset or cash-generating unit, and where no indicator was concluded verify the basis is documented.

title: Provide timely warning of underperformance that may indicate impairment.
description:
Operating and financial performance of significant assets or cash-generating units is monitored against budgets and forecasts, and adverse variances are investigated for possible impairment indicators.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Monthly or quarterly

Responsible: Management / finance

Evidence of operation: Management accounts with variance commentary; investigation notes for adverse variances.

Limitations: Performance information may be prepared on a basis that obscures asset-level underperformance; investigation quality varies.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select periods and inspect the monitoring of significant assets or cash-generating units against budgets and forecasts. Select adverse variances and verify investigation for impairment indicators.

title: Ensure replaced significant parts are removed from the carrying amount.
description:
Major maintenance and replacement work orders identify the component replaced and are routed to finance so the carrying amount of the replaced part can be derecognised when the new part is capitalised.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Per work order

Responsible: Maintenance manager

Evidence of operation: Work orders cross-referenced to derecognition entries in the fixed asset register.

Limitations: Relies on maintenance staff correctly identifying replaced components and on the information reaching finance.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select major maintenance and replacement work orders. Verify the replaced component was identified and routed to finance, and verify derecognition of the replaced part.

title: Enable separate depreciation and derecognition of significant parts.
description:
Significant assets are componentised in the fixed asset register, with major parts recorded separately and depreciated over their own useful lives.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: On recognition of the asset

Responsible: Financial accountant

Evidence of operation: Fixed asset register showing component-level records for significant assets.

Limitations: Componentisation at initial recognition requires judgment about which parts are significant; retrospective componentisation of old assets may be impracticable.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the fixed asset register for componentisation of significant assets. Select assets and verify major parts are recorded separately with their own useful lives.

title: Prevent payment for goods not received.
description:
Supplier invoices are matched to the purchase order and goods received note (three-way match) before approval for payment.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual / Automated

Frequency: Per invoice

Responsible: Accounts payable staff, independent of receiving

Evidence of operation: Matched invoice packs; exception reports of invoices approved without a match.

Limitations: Collusion between receiving and payables staff defeats the match; does not detect overpricing agreed with a genuine supplier.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of payments. Verify the invoice was matched to the purchase order and goods received note before approval for payment, and verify the matcher is independent of ordering and receiving.

title: Detect invoices paid without evidence of receipt.
description:
An exception report of invoices approved without matching GRNs is reviewed independently each month.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Monthly

Responsible: Finance manager

Evidence of operation: Exception report with review sign-off and follow-up actions documented.

Limitations: Detective only - payment may already have been made; relies on the completeness of the matching data.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select months and inspect the exception report of invoices approved without matching GRNs. Verify independent review each month, and select cleared items to verify follow-up.

title: Ensure liabilities for goods received are recorded at the reporting date.
description:
Goods received notes are sequentially controlled; at period end, unmatched GRNs are accrued as liabilities.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: At each period end

Responsible: Finance staff

Evidence of operation: Sequential GRN register; accrual journals with supporting GRN listings; review sign-off.

Limitations: Does not detect goods received without a GRN being raised.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the sequential control over goods received notes. At the period end, select unmatched GRNs and verify accrual as liabilities, and re-perform the unmatched-GRN listing.

title: Record purchases in the correct accounting period.
description:
Purchases are recorded by reference to the goods receipt date, enforced by system posting rules or a period-end cut-off checklist.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual / Automated

Frequency: Per transaction and at period end

Responsible: Accounts payable staff

Evidence of operation: Completed cut-off checklist; system configuration showing posting-date derivation.

Limitations: Manual checklists can be skipped; system rules can be overridden by privileged users.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select purchases around the period end. Verify recording by goods receipt date, and inspect the system posting rules or cut-off checklist that enforces it.

title: Prevent unauthorised or fictitious suppliers entering the payment process.
description:
All additions and changes to supplier master data, including bank details, require independent approval before taking effect.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual / Automated

Frequency: Per change

Responsible: Independent approver (not the requestor)

Evidence of operation: Change log showing requestor, approver and timestamps; supporting supplier verification documents.

Limitations: The approver may not verify the change independently; does not prevent changes by privileged system users.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of supplier master additions and changes, including bank-detail changes. Inspect independent approval before effect, and verify no change took effect unapproved.

title: Detect fictitious or inappropriate suppliers in the master data.
description:
The supplier master file is independently reviewed periodically for duplicate, dormant or suspicious entries.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Quarterly

Responsible: Finance manager / internal audit

Evidence of operation: Review working papers with conclusions and follow-up on flagged suppliers.

Limitations: Judgemental; may not identify well-concealed fictitious suppliers.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the periodic independent review of the supplier master file. Select duplicate, dormant or suspicious entries identified and verify resolution.

title: Prevent the same invoice being recorded twice.
description:
The purchase system rejects or flags duplicate invoice numbers for the same supplier automatically.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Automated

Frequency: Per invoice

Responsible: System (configured by IT / finance)

Evidence of operation: System configuration; exception reports of blocked or flagged duplicates.

Limitations: Only checks invoice number per supplier - the same economic invoice with an altered number passes; manual journals may bypass the check.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Test the duplicate-invoice control with a controlled attempt (or inspect system configuration and rejection logs). Verify duplicate invoice numbers for the same supplier are rejected or flagged and that the control operated during the period.

title: Prevent paid invoices re-entering the payment process.
description:
Paid invoices are physically or systemically marked as paid and filed to prevent reprocessing.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual / Automated

Frequency: Per payment

Responsible: Accounts payable staff

Evidence of operation: Marked invoice copies or system paid flags; controlled filing.

Limitations: Manual marking can be missed under volume pressure.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of paid invoices. Verify each is marked as paid and filed to prevent reprocessing (physical or systemic), and verify the marking cannot be removed without detection.

title: Ensure purchases are recorded in the correct period.
description:
A period-end cut-off checklist requires payables staff to record purchases by goods receipt date and to review post-period invoices for pre-period receipts.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: At each period end

Responsible: Accounts payable supervisor

Evidence of operation: Completed checklist with sign-off.

Limitations: Checklist compliance is not self-proving; time pressure at period end reduces effectiveness.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the completed period-end cut-off checklist. Select post-period invoices reviewed under it and verify pre-period receipts were captured in the correct period.

title: Detect cut-off errors in purchases after the reporting date.
description:
Finance reviews supplier invoices recorded after the reporting date to identify goods received before year-end.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: At each period end

Responsible: Financial controller

Evidence of operation: Review working papers listing post-year-end invoices checked against GRN dates.

Limitations: Only covers invoiced items; uninvoiced receipts still depend on the GRN accrual.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select supplier invoices recorded after the reporting date. Verify each was reviewed for goods received before year-end, and verify accruals were proposed where needed.

title: Prevent revenue being recorded before recognition criteria are met.
description:
Billing is only raised against matched evidence of delivery or performance (for example, a signed delivery note or service completion record) before the sales invoice is generated.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual / Automated

Frequency: Per transaction

Responsible: Billing and dispatch staff

Evidence of operation: Matched invoice-dispatch packs; system exception reports listing invoices raised without dispatch evidence.

Limitations: Can be overridden by management or bypassed with backdated dispatch evidence; ineffective if matching is performed without genuine checking.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of sales invoices. Verify matched evidence of delivery or performance exists dated before the invoice, and verify billing cannot be raised without it (or inspect the manual check performed).

title: Detect premature revenue recognition around the period end.
description:
The finance manager independently reviews revenue transactions recorded in the final days of the period, and credit notes issued shortly after, for evidence that recognition criteria were met.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: At each period end

Responsible: Finance manager

Evidence of operation: Review checklist with sign-off; supporting dispatch evidence attached to reviewed items.

Limitations: Judgement-based; only as effective as the evidence inspected; cannot detect side agreements the reviewer never sees.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the finance manager's independent review of revenue recorded in the final days of the period. Select credit notes issued shortly after period end and verify the original revenue met the recognition criteria.

title: Detect sales earned but not recorded at the reporting date.
description:
Dispatch notes are sequentially controlled and reconciled to sales invoices at each period end; unmatched dispatches are accrued as revenue.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: At each period end

Responsible: Finance / sales ledger staff

Evidence of operation: Sequential dispatch register; period-end reconciliation with sign-off; accrual journals for unmatched dispatches.

Limitations: Does not detect dispatches never recorded in the register; relies on the completeness of the dispatch records themselves.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the sequential control over dispatch notes and the period-end reconciliation to sales invoices. Select unmatched dispatches and verify revenue accrual, and re-perform the reconciliation.

title: Ensure sales are recorded in the correct accounting period.
description:
Sales are recorded by reference to the dispatch or completion date, enforced by the billing system or a documented period-end cut-off checklist.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual / Automated

Frequency: Per transaction and at period end

Responsible: Billing staff

Evidence of operation: Completed cut-off checklist; system configuration showing posting-date derivation.

Limitations: Manual checklists can be skipped under time pressure; system dates can be overridden by privileged users.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select sales around the period end. Verify recording by dispatch or completion date, and inspect the billing-system enforcement or cut-off checklist.

title: Prevent sales being recorded without evidence of dispatch or performance.
description:
A three-way match of sales order, dispatch note and invoice is required before a credit sale is released for billing.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual / Automated

Frequency: Per transaction

Responsible: Billing staff, independent of dispatch

Evidence of operation: Matched order-dispatch-invoice packs; exception reports of invoices released without a match.

Limitations: Collusion between billing and dispatch staff defeats the match; does not validate the genuineness of the customer.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select a sample of credit sales. Verify the sales order, dispatch note and invoice were matched before the sale was released for billing.

title: Detect unsupported sales promptly.
description:
An exception report of invoices raised without matching dispatch evidence is reviewed independently and cleared with documented follow-up.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Weekly / monthly

Responsible: Finance manager

Evidence of operation: Exception report with review sign-off and follow-up notes for each item.

Limitations: Detective only; only as good as the underlying matching data; review may be perfunctory under time pressure.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select weeks and inspect the exception report of invoices raised without matching dispatch evidence. Verify independent review and documented clearance of each item.

title: Provide independent oversight of revenue susceptible to manipulation.
description:
Those charged with governance, or an independent senior manager, review significant revenue judgements and the achievement of incentive-linked targets.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Quarterly / at year end

Responsible: Audit committee / board

Evidence of operation: Meeting minutes recording the review and challenge of revenue judgements.

Limitations: Non-executive reviewers rely on management information; review may be high-level and miss detailed manipulation.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Inspect the minutes or records of the independent review of significant revenue judgements and incentive-linked target achievement. Verify challenge was documented, not just noted.

title: Prevent unauthorised or unsupported manual adjustments to revenue.
description:
Manual journal entries affecting revenue above a defined threshold require independent approval with supporting documentation.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual / Automated

Frequency: Per journal

Responsible: Finance manager / controller

Evidence of operation: Approved journals with supporting schedules attached; approval audit trail.

Limitations: Thresholds can be circumvented by splitting entries; an approver under time pressure may not check substance.
source_ref: audit-risk-library v1.2 (2026-10-22); Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
test_of_controls: Select manual journal entries affecting revenue above the threshold. Inspect independent approval with supporting documentation before posting.

title: Ensure unusual transactions have genuine commercial substance before they are recorded.
description:
Non-routine and individually material transactions require a documented business rationale and authorisation by senior management before recording.

Type: Preventive

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: Per transaction

Responsible: Senior management

Evidence of operation: Authorisation forms with the business rationale attached.

Limitations: Authorisers may not understand complex structures; the rationale may be prepared after the event to justify the accounting.

title: Detect year-end transactions recorded without substance or in the wrong period.
description:
Finance reviews all material transactions recorded in the final days of the reporting period, including the supporting contracts.

Type: Detective

Manual/automated: Manual

Frequency: At each period end

Responsible: Financial controller

Evidence of operation: Review working papers with conclusions documented for each item reviewed.

Limitations: Review is judgemental and time-pressured at year end; cannot detect documents deliberately concealed from the reviewer.
